title.zh: Exa 3.0搜索Token消耗减少47%，独立评测追平 Perplexity
title.en: Exa 3.0搜索Token消耗减少47%，独立评测追平 Perplexity

current_state.zh: Exa launched Exa 3.0, its AI-agent web search API, claiming a benchmark tie with Perplexity Search and a 47% cut in per-task token consumption via consolidated Dynamic Highlights, alongside a larger embedding model, a broader real-time data index, and new Lite/Auto pricing.
